internal_faq.question: How is this different from Discord — why would traders leave Discord for this?
internal_faq.answer: The core differentiator is execution integration. In Discord, a trader sees a setup, copies the ticker, switches to their brokerage app, searches for the ticker, opens the order screen, and executes — 6–8 minutes. In xCube Chat, they tap the live ticker card in the message and they're on the pre-filled order screen. We're not asking traders to leave Discord; we're giving them a reason to do the discussion where they already execute. The ticker card is the moat — Discord can't replicate the order flow.

internal_faq.question: Is the chat moderated? What happens if someone posts pump-and-dump signals?
internal_faq.answer: Yes. Every message passes through two layers of moderation before delivery. First, rule-based checks (blocklist, URL detection, ticker velocity — same ticker mentioned >10× in 5 min triggers review). Second, an async LLM classifier at >92% precision for pump-and-dump signals and unsolicited investment advice. Messages flagged at either stage are held for human review and not delivered. Our zero-tolerance policy is published. We have a dedicated compliance reviewer on-call for the first 30 days.

internal_faq.question: Is this MiFID II compliant? What are our record-keeping obligations?
internal_faq.answer: All messages are retained in cold storage for 7 years, which meets the MiFID II Article 16 maximum record-keeping requirement. Legal has signed off on the interpretation that general topic-channel discussion does not constitute investment advice requiring transaction-level reporting — but we retain everything regardless to avoid ambiguity. The compliance team has Athena query access to the full archive for regulatory requests.

internal_faq.question: Can traders send direct messages to each other?
internal_faq.answer: Not in the current release. MVP is public channels only. Direct messages are on the Phase 2 roadmap. The channel-first approach is intentional — traders self-organise by ticker and strategy, not social graph, and public channels create stronger network effects and more discoverable content. DMs add complexity without proportionate demand signal at MVP.

internal_faq.question: What if the influencer partner promotes positions they hold in their channel?
internal_faq.answer: Each influencer partnership agreement includes an explicit disclosure requirement: influencers must disclose material positions in any ticker they discuss in their xCube channel, consistent with FCA/SEC influencer guidelines. The partnership terms are reviewed by Legal before signing. Moderation also monitors influencer channels for velocity patterns that could indicate coordinated position promotion. Any breach triggers immediate channel suspension and contract termination.
